read.en: Micron fell 1.0% on Nov 18 to $705.27, trading $687.34–722.96. It is below the 10-day ($732.9, falling), 5-day ($742.7), rising 200-day ($769.9), and the falling 30-day ($854.3) and 100-day ($929.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($836.55), and RSI is 37.0.
read.zh: 美光 11月18日下跌 1.0%，收于 $705.27，盘中区间 $687.34–722.96。股价位于 10 日（$732.9，下行）、5 日（$742.7）、上行的 200 日均线（$769.9）以及下行的 30 日（$854.3）和 100 日均线（$929.5）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$836.55），RSI 为 37.0。

read.en: The $687.34 low broke the $699.6 support and the $689.7–690 band intraday, but the close held above $699.6 for a second day, while the $723 high was capped below the Nov 10 close. Resistance is $712–725, then $733–746 (10 and 5-day, Nov 9–10) and $770 (200-day). Support is $699.6, then $687.3–690 and $667. A close above $725 would target $733–746; below $687, $667.
